description.zh: 基于当前 Operit 角色卡的可触摸虚拟小猪。交互立即本地响应并批量记录，下一次正常聊天时自动告知角色。
description.en: A touchable virtual pig with instant local reactions; interactions are batched into the active Operit character context on the next normal reply.

description.en: Inspect pet state and send pet actions.
